title: Animated.modulo can be negative when `useNativeDriver: true`

labels.name: Issue: Author Provided Repro
labels.description: This issue can be reproduced in Snack or an attached project.

labels.name: Resolution: Locked
labels.description: This issue was locked by the bot.

body:
## 🐛 Bug Report
`Animated.modulo` always returns positive value when animation is used without `useNativeDriver`.
If animation uses `useNativeDriver` then output of `Animated.modulo` can be negative

![gif](https://github.com/maxkomarychev/rn-animated-modulo-bug/raw/master/bug.gif)

## To Reproduce
[TL;DR - sample code](https://github.com/maxkomarychev/rn-animated-modulo-bug/blob/master/App.js#L17-L76)

1. create animated value
2. initialize animated to negative value
3. create `timing` animation to positive value
4. create view using `Animated.modulo`
5. observe when animation is launched with `useNativeDriver` the result of `.modulo` is negative.


## Expected Behavior
I am not 100% sure understand what is the reason of keeping `modulo` always positive but it should at least work according to docs: https://facebook.github.io/react-native/docs/animated#modulo

> Creates a new Animated value that is the (non-negative) modulo of the provided Animated value



## Code Example

Sample project can be found here: https://github.com/maxkomarychev/rn-animated-modulo-bug
